The NOT EXISTS is checking if there exists any bar that the drinker frequents (f.bar) where the bar serves a beer not in their likes. So if there's even one such bar, the drinker is excluded. Q2, on the other hand, selects from the frequents table (so for each (drinker, bar) pair), and checks that there does not exist a beer served at that bar which the drinker doesn't like. So the result is all drinkers who have at least one bar that they frequent where all beers at that bar are liked. Whereas Q1 requires that all bars the drinker frequents meet the condition.
